SIX-BOX: (1)PRIOR: init_t axis strongly MONOTONIC: 0.7 rmse0.0428/ssim0.427 -> 0.3 rmse0.0264/ssim0.454 -> 0.15 rmse0.0144/ssim0.676. Recon approaches the 128-view breast FBP (rmse0.00521,ssim0.920) as init_t->0. All hr=0. (2)FAILURE: recon still 2.8x FBP rmse at init_t0.15; the breast prior perturbs the near-oracle FBP rather than improving it. (3)ONE KNOB: init_t 0.15->0.05 (embed almost AT the FBP). (4)HYPOTHESIS: at init_t~0 the recon converges TO the FBP so rmse->0.00521 and hr->0 from below (equal to baseline, cannot exceed). This maps the init_t asymptote: if rmse bottoms at the FBP floor, it PROVES the sparse-view breast FBP is already near-oracle (128 views is not very sparse at this geometry) and a prior has no noise headroom to exploit -> regime-bound ceiling, distinct from the Mayo prior-mismatch cause. (5)BUDGET: minimal steps, fast. (6)Serial.
